<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons. The only way to get information is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample, which should list chemical shifts for each carbon. Aromatic carbons typically appear in the 110‑160 ppm region. By counting the peaks in that region we can determine the aromatic carbon count. We'll request the 13C NMR spectrum using the provided tool.</thought>
